ALTF__Long_Description__c:
They want to consolidate and standardize their processes by bringing everything into Salesforce.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "that's why we want to bring it into Salesforce and make it consistent"

ALTF__Short_Description__c: Better practices, efficient time use, intelligent sharing
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
They want to work more efficiently and share intelligence across the team rather than duplicating effort or missing connections.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "the driver is better business practices, more efficient use of our time and intelligent sharing"

ALTF__Short_Description__c: Ideal: 2-3 large multi-site accounts per person
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
Each person should own 2-3 large, multi-site accounts with significant volume and revenue.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "I would say the ideal thing would be to have two or three key accounts, truly like large volume, large revenue, multi-site accounts for each person"

Resourcing constraints are their primary pressure.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "I'd say our key pressures are, well, number one, like resourcing in general"

They are actively moving toward a key account management model.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "we have like, you know, we're moving towards a key account model"

ALTF__Short_Description__c: Sales targets vs. IT cloud compliance tension
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
Sales leaders using Salesforce face challenges meeting IT cloud compliance and adherence requirements.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "We have a lot of like principal consultants and practice area leads that have sales targets that use Salesforce that are, Taylor, what's the PC way to say it? Challenging from an IT cloud compliance adherence perspective, if you will."

ALTF__Short_Description__c: Inconsistent process depending on who's in charge
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
Their current process is highly inconsistent depending on who manages it, which is why they want Salesforce to enforce consistency.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "Oh, it's the most inconsistent. I mean, it's just depends on who's sort of in charge of it. So, I mean, that's why we want to bring it into Salesforce and make it consistent."

ALTF__Short_Description__c: Email tracking gap at opportunity/contact level
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
Email tracking to opportunity and contact level in Salesforce is missing, creating a gap they acknowledge as their own.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "And then, again, that's reliant on e-mail tracking to an opportunity or contact level within Salesforce, so that's that's a gap, but that's our own gap"

ALTF__Short_Description__c: No visibility into internal relationships and connections
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
The team lacks visibility into who knows whom internally and which relationships matter for account expansion.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "we don't have connectivity across our own internal team as to who knows who and like. who we need to be talking to."

ALTF__Short_Description__c: Silos across manufacturing networks, unknown relationships
ALTF__Long_Description__c:
They operate in isolated silos within the same company's manufacturing networks and don't leverage or even know about existing relationships to expand beyond current sites.

Source: Adam Pfeiffer, 30 July 2026, projectfarma/2026-07-30-nf1.

In their words: "we tend to operate in silos across manufacturing networks for the same company. So we don't necessarily leverage the relationships or the right relationships or even know which relationships to leverage to expand outside of the existing site we're working on."
